Stack tracks over shared genomic windows

Source: R/stack-tracks.R
stack_tracks.Rd

Stacks tracks vertically with patchwork, giving every track the same genomic windows so their x-axes line up. Each track gets the same coord_loci() or coord_genome(), window labels are kept on the top track only, and the x-axis labels on the bottom track only. Tracks with another coord, such as the ideogram from plot_ideogram(), are stacked as they are.

Usage

stack_tracks(
  ...,
  windows = NULL,
  flank = 0,
  widths = c("proportional", "equal"),
  gap = 0.02,
  dividers = TRUE,
  window_labels = NULL,
  heights = NULL,
  upper_x_axis = c("ticks", "blank", "keep"),
  guides = "collect",
  highlight = NULL,
  highlight_args = list()
)

Arguments

...

Tracks to stack, top to bottom, as ggplots or a single list of ggplots. Tracks need no coord of their own.

windows

Windows to show on every track, as for coord_loci(), or "genome" for coord_genome(). Default: the windows of the first track that has a coord_loci() or coord_locus().

flank

Number of bp to extend both ends of each window, default: 0

widths

How the axis is shared between windows: "proportional" (default) to each window's length in bp, or "equal" so small windows stay readable next to large ones, each then at its own scale.

gap

Space between windows as a fraction of the total axis, default: 0.02

dividers

Draw dashed lines between windows, default: TRUE

window_labels

Labels of the windows on the top axis, as one of:

  • NULL (default): labeled with more than one window, by the names of windows or else the chromosome.

  • A character vector with one label per window.

  • TRUE or FALSE to show or hide the default labels. In a stack, keep the labels on the top track only.

heights

Relative heights of the tracks, default: equal

upper_x_axis

Bottom x-axis style of the tracks above the bottom track: "ticks" (default), "blank", or "keep" to leave each track's own theme.

guides

Passed to patchwork::wrap_plots(), default: "collect" to gather legends on the right.

highlight

Regions to highlight across the stack, as for highlight_stack(). Default: none.

highlight_args

List of other arguments passed to highlight_stack(), e.g. list(fill = c("#9BD08A", "#DC766F"), legend_title = "Windows").

Value

A patchwork, or with highlight, a highlighted stack from highlight_stack()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
windows <- c(MYC = "chr8:126500001-129500000", IGH = "chr14:105550001-106100000")

stack_tracks(
  ggplot2::ggplot(junctions) + geom_junction(ggplot2::aes(colour = type)) + theme_genomic(),
  ggplot2::ggplot(cn) + geom_copy_number(cn_cap = 8) + theme_genomic(),
  ggplot2::ggplot() + geom_gene_track(genes_of_interest = c("MYC", "IGHM")) +
    theme_genomic(y_axis = "blank"),
  windows = windows, heights = c(1, 1, 0.5))
} # }
